subs.math: The 8,000 sends a month cover 4,000 campaign emails to 1,000 subscribers.
$19 + 5 × $2.58 per extra 1,000 sends = $31.90 for 20,000 emails a month.
The 50,000-send tier covers 40,000 emails a month to 10,000 subscribers.
$112 + 100 × $1.39 per extra 1,000 sends = $251 for 200,000 emails a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails fit inside the 6,000 monthly and 200 a day free limits, when evenly spread at 100 a day.
$9 + 2 × $2.58 per extra 1,000 = $14.16 for 10,000 sends, evenly spread at about 334 a day.
The Essential 50K volume tier covers 50,000 emails a month.
The Premium 100K volume tier covers 100,000 emails a month.
